title: Easter
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says why Christians celebrate Easter (Jesus' death and resurrection) and names the events and activities of Easter.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus died on the cross out of love.
floor.question: What did Jesus' death show?

representations: a three-day strip: Friday, Saturday, Sunday

board.do: Write three days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
Wait for the child to say Jesus rose from the dead.

misconceptions.ask: What do Christians remember at Easter?
misconceptions.repair: Put Christmas and Easter cards side by side: birth, and death and rising.

misconceptions.ask: What did the women find at the tomb (Matthew 28:6)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 28:6 and show an empty tomb picture.

misconceptions.ask: On which day did Jesus rise from the dead?
misconceptions.repair: Draw three days: Friday death, Saturday tomb, Sunday risen.

misconceptions.ask: Why is Easter important to Christians?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens in church at Easter and why.

checks.question: What do Christians remember at Easter?
